title: ERC20 Token Launch Readiness Sample
summary: Owner centralization, missing multisig, and allowance UX require review before launch.
high_findings: Owner can change sensitive launch settings from a single wallet
No documented multisig or timelock process for privileged functions
priority_actions: Move owner/admin powers to multisig before launch
Publish owner privilege disclosure on website
Add clear approval/spender explanation in wallet flow
Request manual pre-audit review before mainnet launch

title: NFT Mint dApp Sample
summary: Mint flow needs clearer transaction preview, metadata freeze plan, and website headers.
high_findings: Mint page does not clearly display contract address, chain, and total transaction cost
Metadata freeze plan is missing from founder transparency copy
priority_actions: Add chain ID and verified contract link near mint button
Document metadata freeze or mutability policy
Enable CSP/HSTS headers on landing page

title: Staking dApp Sample
summary: Reward calculation, privileged admin roles, and API abuse protection require manual review.
critical_findings: Reward distribution logic needs manual review because it can affect user funds
high_findings: No rate-limit or abuse protection documented for rewards/claim API
Admin wallet and treasury operation process is not documented
priority_actions: Freeze launch until reward math is reviewed
Add rate limiting and webhook/request validation

title: Website-only Web3 Landing Page Sample
summary: Website has HTTPS but needs stronger browser security headers and clearer anti-phishing trust copy.
priority_actions: Add official links and contract address verification section
Add clear disclaimer that users must verify domain before wallet connection
